Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and then a proposal attached for the PO text: basic wording + billing flow + passback evidence checklist.

1) List-price preservation: Redwood supports published SKU list prices while attaching a private-offer token (private offer id) that controls effective price for the customer. The marketplace listing remains unchanged. In practice we pass a PO link/ID at purchase time — the partner and customer invoice will reference the PO but public list remains intact.

2) Channel margin waterfall: we can implement a phased passback. Our typical approach is:
  - Month 0–12: distributor passback = 12% of net invoice credits (calculated on committed node-hour redeemed)
  - Month 13+: passback adjusted to 8%
  - Evidence: monthly export (CSV) with invoice id, bucketed usage, and passback amount. Reconciliation window: 60 days.

I've attached a short PO draft and an uplift-runway workbook for your procurement and distributor. Connor — can you please confirm the billing export format and whether we need a separate usage SKU for first-year credits (so finance can map to passback lines)? Vanessa — want to confirm partner ledger handling for EU VAT flows.

Thanks — Evelyn
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
